header.label: Energy performance — NTA 8800
header.title: Open Energy Studio
header.desc: Open-source building energy performance calculator following the Dutch NTA 8800 standard. BENG calculations, U-value analysis, heat pump sizing, and thermal bridge assessment.

beng.title: BENG calculations
beng.desc: Building Energy Performance (BENG) calculations following the Dutch NTA 8800 standard with BENG indicator visualization.

uvalue.title: U-value calculator
uvalue.desc: Calculate thermal transmittance (U-value) of wall, roof, and floor constructions.

heatpump.title: Heat pump sizing
heatpump.desc: Calculate required heat pump capacity based on building properties and climate data.

thermal.title: Thermal bridge calculator
thermal.desc: Assess thermal bridges and their impact on energy performance.

charts.title: Energy breakdown charts
charts.desc: Visual energy breakdown and monthly performance analysis charts.

building3d.title: 3D building view
building3d.desc: 3D visualization of the building envelope and its thermal properties.

projects.title: Project management
projects.desc: Project browser for managing multiple buildings. Properties panel for detailed parameter editing.

reporting.title: Reporting
reporting.desc: Generate energy performance reports with print preview. Ribbon toolbar interface with settings dialog.

tauri.title: Tauri 2
tauri.desc: Native desktop application with Rust backend. CalVer versioning (YEAR.MONTH.BUILD).

react.title: React 18 + TypeScript
react.desc: Component-based UI with Vite build tooling.
